en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: None of you should sell over another's sale.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: None of you should sell over another's Verkauf. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us, and the wording is Zuhayr's. They both said: Yahya narrated to us, from Ubayd Allah, who informed me, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: A man must not sell over his brother's sale, nor propose over his brother's proposal, unless he gives him permission.
de: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns, and the wording is Zuhayr's. They both said: Yahya überlieferte uns, from Ubayd Allah, who berichtete mir, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), who said: A man must not sell over his brother's Verkauf, nor propose over his brother's Heiratsantrag, unless he gives him permission. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Amr al-Naqid, Zuhayr ibn Harb, and Ibn Abi Umar narrated to me. Zuhayr said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id, from Abu Hurayra. The Prophet (peace be upon him) forbade a townsman from selling on behalf of a desert dweller, engaging in artificial bidding, a man proposing over his brother's proposal, selling over his brother's sale, and a woman asking for her sister's divorce to take what is in her vessel or dish. Amr added in his narration: A man must not bid over his brother's bid.
de: Amr al-Naqid, Zuhayr ibn Harb, and Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte mir. Zuhayr said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah überlieferte uns, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id, from Abu Hurayra. The Prophet (peace be upon him) forbade a townsman from selling on behalf of a desert dweller, engaging in artificial Gebotding, a man proposing over his brother's Heiratsantrag, selling over his brother's Verkauf, and a woman asking for her sister's divorce to take what is in her vessel or dish. Amr added in his narration: A man must not Gebot over his brother's Gebot. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me. Ibn Wahb informed us. Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab. Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib narrated to me that Abu Hurayra said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Do not engage in artificial bidding. A person must not sell over his brother's sale, a townsman must not sell on behalf of a desert dweller, a person must not propose over his brother's proposal, and a woman must not ask for another woman's divorce to take what is in her vessel.
de: Harmalah ibn Yahya überlieferte mir. Ibn Wahb berichtete uns. Yunus berichtete mir, from Ibn Shihab. Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib überlieferte mir that Abu Hurayra said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Do not engage in artificial Gebotding. A person must not sell over his brother's Verkauf, a townsman must not sell on behalf of a desert dweller, a person must not propose over his brother's Heiratsantrag, and a woman must not ask for another woman's divorce to take what is in her vessel. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Abd al-Ala narrated to us. Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to me. Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us. All of them narrated from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, with this chain and the same meaning, except that Ma'mar's narration says: A man must not increase over his brother's sale.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Abd al-Ala überlieferte uns. Muhammad ibn Rafi überlieferte mir. Abd al-Razzaq überlieferte uns. All of them narrated from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, with this chain and the same meaning, except that Ma'mar's narration says: A man must not increase over his brother's Verkauf. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Ayyub, Qutaybah, and Ibn Hujr narrated to us, all from Ismail ibn Jafar. Ibn Ayyub said: Ismail narrated to us. Al-Ala informed me, from his father, from Abu Hurayra, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A Muslim must not bid over his brother's bid, nor propose over his proposal.
de: Yahya ibn Ayyub, Qutaybah, and Ibn Hujr überlieferte uns, all from Ismail ibn Jafar. Ibn Ayyub said: Ismail überlieferte uns. Al-Ala berichtete mir, from his father, from Abu Hurayra, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: A Muslim must not Gebot over his brother's Gebot, nor propose over his Heiratsantrag. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Dawraqi narrated to me. Abd al-Samad narrated to us. Shubah narrated to us, from al-Ala and Suhayl, from their fathers, from Abu Hurayra, from the Prophet (peace be upon him). He also narrated it to us through Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna: Abd al-Samad narrated to us, from Shubah, from al-Amash, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurayra, from the Prophet (peace be upon him). They said: over his brother's bid and his brother's proposal.
de: Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Dawraqi überlieferte mir. Abd al-Samad überlieferte uns. Shubah überlieferte uns, from al-Ala and Suhayl, from their fathers, from Abu Hurayra, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm). He also narrated it to us through Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna: Abd al-Samad überlieferte uns, from Shubah, from al-Amash, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurayra, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm). They said: over his brother's Gebot and his brother's Heiratsantrag. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu al-Tahir narrated to me. Abd Allah ibn Wahb informed us, from al-Layth and others, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Shumasah. He heard Uqbah ibn Amir say on the pulpit: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: The believer is the brother of the believer. It is not lawful for a believer to buy over his brother's sale or propose over his brother's proposal until he leaves it.
de: Abu al-Tahir überlieferte mir. Abd Allah ibn Wahb berichtete uns, from al-Layth and others, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Shumasah. He heard Uqbah ibn Amir say on the pulpit: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: The believer is the brother of the believer. It is not lawful for a believer to buy over his brother's Verkauf or propose over his brother's Heiratsantrag until he leaves it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade shighar. Shighar is when a man marries his daughter to another man on the condition that the other marries his daughter to him, with no dowry between them.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) forbade shighar. Shighar is when a man marries his daughter to another man on the condition that the other marries his daughter to him, with no Brautgabe between them. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Zuhayr ibn Harb, Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna, and Ubayd Allah ibn Sa'id narrated to me. They said: Yahya narrated to us, from Ubayd Allah, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), with the same meaning. In Ubayd Allah's narration he said: I asked Nafi, what is shighar?
de: Zuhayr ibn Harb, Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna, and Ubayd Allah ibn Sa'id überlieferte mir. They said: Yahya überlieferte uns, from Ubayd Allah, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), with the same meaning. In Ubayd Allah's narration he said: I asked Nafi, what is shighar? Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. Hammad ibn Zayd informed us, from Abd al-Rahman al-Sarraj, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade shighar.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Hammad ibn Zayd berichtete uns, from Abd al-Rahman al-Sarraj, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) forbade shighar. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to me. Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us. Ma'mar informed us, from Ayyub, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: There is no shighar in Islam.
de: Muhammad ibn Rafi überlieferte mir. Abd al-Razzaq überlieferte uns. Ma'mar berichtete uns, from Ayyub, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) said: There is no shighar in Islam. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Ibn Numayr and Abu Usamah narrated to us, from Ubayd Allah, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayra. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade shighar. Ibn Numayr added: Shighar is when a man says to another man, marry me your daughter and I will marry you my daughter, or marry me your sister and I will marry you my sister.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Ibn Numayr and Abu Usamah überlieferte uns, from Ubayd Allah, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayra. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade shighar. Ibn Numayr added: Shighar is when a man says to another man, marry me your daughter and I will marry you my daughter, or marry me your sister and I will marry you my sister. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Kurayb Muhammad ibn al-Ala narrated it to us. Abda narrated to us, from Ubayd Allah ibn Umar, with this chain, but he did not mention Ibn Numayr's addition.
de: Abu Kurayb Muhammad ibn al-Ala narrated it to us. Abda überlieferte uns, from Ubayd Allah ibn Umar, with this chain, but he did not mention Ibn Numayr's addition. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Harun ibn Abd Allah narrated to me. Hajjaj ibn Muhammad narrated to us. He said: Ibn Jurayj said. Ishaq ibn Ibrahim and Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated it to us, from Abd al-Razzaq. Ibn Jurayj informed us. Abu al-Zubayr informed me that he heard Jabir ibn Abd Allah say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade shighar.
de: Harun ibn Abd Allah überlieferte mir. Hajjaj ibn Muhammad überlieferte uns. Er sagte: Ibn Jurayj said. Ishaq ibn Ibrahim and Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated it to us, from Abd al-Razzaq. Ibn Jurayj berichtete uns. Abu al-Zubayr berichtete mir that he heard Jabir ibn Abd Allah say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade shighar. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Ayyub narrated to us. Hushaym narrated to us. Ibn Numayr narrated to us. Waki narrated to us. Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Abu Khalid al-Ahmar narrated to us. Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us, and Yahya, al-Qattan, narrated to us, from Abd al-Hamid ibn Jafar, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Marthad ibn Abd Allah al-Yazani, from Uqbah ibn Amir. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: The condition most deserving of fulfillment is the one by which you made the private parts lawful. This is the wording of Abu Bakr and Ibn al-Muthanna. Ibn al-Muthanna's wording says: conditions.
de: Yahya ibn Ayyub überlieferte uns. Hushaym überlieferte uns. Ibn Numayr überlieferte uns. Waki überlieferte uns. Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Abu Khalid al-Ahmar überlieferte uns. Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns, and Yahya, al-Qattan, überlieferte uns, from Abd al-Hamid ibn Jafar, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Marthad ibn Abd Allah al-Yazani, from Uqbah ibn Amir. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: The condition most deserving of fulfillment is the one by which you made the private parts lawful. This is the wording of Abu Bakr and Ibn al-Muthanna. Ibn al-Muthanna's wording says: conditions. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Ubayd Allah ibn Umar ibn Maysarah al-Qawariri narrated to me. Khalid ibn al-Harith narrated to us. Hisham narrated to us, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir. Abu Salamah narrated to us. Abu Hurayra narrated to us that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A previously married woman must not be married until she is consulted, and a virgin must not be married until her permission is sought. They asked: Messenger of Allah, how is her permission? He said: That she remains silent.
de: Ubayd Allah ibn Umar ibn Maysarah al-Qawariri überlieferte mir. Khalid ibn al-Harith überlieferte uns. Hisham überlieferte uns, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir. Abu Salamah überlieferte uns. Abu Hurayra überlieferte uns that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: A zuvor verheiratete Frau must not be married until she is consulted, and a Jungfrau must not be married until her permission is sought. They asked: Messenger of Allah, how is her permission? Er sagte: That she remains silent. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me. Ismail ibn Ibrahim narrated to us. al-Hajjaj ibn Abi Uthman narrated to us. Ibrahim ibn Musa narrated to me. Isa, meaning Ibn Yunus, informed us, from al-Awzai. Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me. Husayn ibn Muhammad narrated to us. Shayban narrated to us. Amr al-Naqid and Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to me. They both said: Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us, from Ma'mar. Abd Allah ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Darimi informed us. Yahya ibn Hassan narrated to us. Muawiyah narrated to us. All of them narrated from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir with the meaning and chain of Hisham's hadith. The wording of Hisham, Shayban, and Muawiyah ibn Sallam agrees in this hadith.
de: Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte mir. Ismail ibn Ibrahim überlieferte uns. al-Hajjaj ibn Abi Uthman überlieferte uns. Ibrahim ibn Musa überlieferte mir. Isa, meaning Ibn Yunus, berichtete uns, from al-Awzai. Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte mir. Husayn ibn Muhammad überlieferte uns. Shayban überlieferte uns. Amr al-Naqid and Muhammad ibn Rafi überlieferte mir. They both said: Abd al-Razzaq überlieferte uns, from Ma'mar. Abd Allah ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Darimi berichtete uns. Yahya ibn Hassan überlieferte uns. Muawiyah überlieferte uns. All of them narrated from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir with the meaning and chain of Hisham's hadith. The wording of Hisham, Shayban, and Muawiyah ibn Sallam agrees in this hadith. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Abd Allah ibn Idris narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj. Ishaq ibn Ibrahim and Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to us, both from Abd al-Razzaq, and the wording is Ibn Rafi's. Abd al-Razzaq informed us. Ibn Jurayj said: I heard Ibn Abi Mulaykah say that Dhakwan, the freedman of Aisha, said: I heard Aisha say: I asked the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) about a young woman whom her family marries: should she be consulted or not? The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said to her: Yes, she should be consulted. Aisha said: I told him that she would be shy. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: That is her permission when she remains silent.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Abd Allah ibn Idris überlieferte uns, from Ibn Jurayj. Ishaq ibn Ibrahim and Muhammad ibn Rafi überlieferte uns, both from Abd al-Razzaq, and the wording is Ibn Rafi's. Abd al-Razzaq berichtete uns. Ibn Jurayj said: I heard Ibn Abi Mulaykah say that Dhakwan, the freedman of Aisha, said: I heard Aisha say: I asked der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) about a young woman whom her family marries: should she be consulted or not? The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said to her: Yes, she should be consulted. Aisha said: I told him that she would be shy. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: That is her permission when she remains silent. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Sa'id ibn Mansur and Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. They both said: Malik narrated to us. Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us, and his is the wording. He said: I asked Malik whether Abd Allah ibn al-Fadl narrated to him, from Nafi ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, that the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: A previously married woman has more right to herself than her guardian, and a virgin's permission is sought regarding herself; her permission is her silence. He said: Yes.
de: Sa'id ibn Mansur and Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns. They both said: Malik überlieferte uns. Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns, and his is the wording. Er sagte: I asked Malik whether Abd Allah ibn al-Fadl narrated to him, from Nafi ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, that der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) said: A zuvor verheiratete Frau has more right to herself than her guardian, and a Jungfrau's permission is sought regarding herself; her permission is her Schweigen. Er sagte: Yes. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us, from Ziyad ibn Sad, from Abd Allah ibn al-Fadl, who heard Nafi ibn Jubayr report from Ibn Abbas that the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: A previously married woman has more right to herself than her guardian. A virgin is consulted, and her permission is her silence.
de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns. Sufyan überlieferte uns, from Ziyad ibn Sad, from Abd Allah ibn al-Fadl, who heard Nafi ibn Jubayr report from Ibn Abbas that der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) said: A zuvor verheiratete Frau has more right to herself than her guardian. A Jungfrau is consulted, and her permission is her Schweigen. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us with this chain and said: A previously married woman has more right to herself than her guardian, and her father seeks the virgin's permission regarding herself; her permission is her silence. Sometimes he said: Her silence is her acknowledgement.
de: Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns. Sufyan überlieferte uns with this chain and said: A zuvor verheiratete Frau has more right to herself than her guardian, and her father seeks the Jungfrau's permission regarding herself; her permission is her Schweigen. Sometimes he said: Her Schweigen is her acknowledgement. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Kurayb Muhammad ibn al-Ala narrated to us. Abu Usamah narrated to us. Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. He said: I found in my book, from Abu Usamah, from Hisham, from his father, from Aisha. She said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) married me when I was six years old and consummated the marriage with me when I was nine. She said: We came to Madinah, and I was ill for a month. My hair grew into two locks. Umm Ruman came to me while I was on a swing with my companions. She called me, and I went to her without knowing what she wanted. She took my hand and stopped me at the door. I said: Ah, ah, until my breath was gone. She brought me into a house where there were women from the Ansar. They said: With goodness and blessing, and with the best fortune. They handed me to them. They washed my head and prepared me. The only thing that startled me was the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) arriving in the forenoon, and they handed me over to him.
de: Abu Kurayb Muhammad ibn al-Ala überlieferte uns. Abu Usamah überlieferte uns. Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I found in my book, from Abu Usamah, from Hisham, from his father, from Aisha. She said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) married me when I was six years old and consummated the Ehe with me when I was nine. She said: We came to Madinah, and I was ill for a month. My hair grew into two locks. Umm Ruman came to me while I was on a swing with my companions. She called me, and I went to her without knowing what she wanted. She took my hand and stopped me at the door. I said: Ah, ah, until my breath was gone. She brought me into a house where there were women from the Ansar. They said: With goodness and blessing, and with the best fortune. They handed me to them. They washed my head and prepared me. The only thing that startled me was der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) arriving in the forenoon, and they handed me over to him. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. Abu Muawiyah informed us, from Hisham ibn Urwah. Ibn Numayr narrated to us, and his is the wording. Abda, meaning Ibn Sulayman, narrated to us, from Hisham, from his father, from Aisha. She said: The Prophet (peace be upon him) married me when I was six years old and consummated the marriage with me when I was nine.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Abu Muawiyah berichtete uns, from Hisham ibn Urwah. Ibn Numayr überlieferte uns, and his is the wording. Abda, meaning Ibn Sulayman, überlieferte uns, from Hisham, from his father, from Aisha. She said: The Prophet (peace be upon him) married me when I was six years old and consummated the Ehe with me when I was nine. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us. Abd al-Razzaq informed us. Ma'mar informed us, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha, that the Prophet (peace be upon him) married her when she was seven years old, she was brought to him when she was nine, and her dolls were with her. He died while she was eighteen.
de: Abd ibn Humayd überlieferte uns. Abd al-Razzaq berichtete uns. Ma'mar berichtete uns, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha, that der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) married her when she was seven years old, she was brought to him when she was nine, and her dolls were with her. He died while she was eighteen. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya, Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, and Abu Kurayb narrated to us. Yahya and Ishaq said: He informed us. The other two said: Abu Muawiyah narrated to us, from al-Amash, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from Aisha. She said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) married her when she was six, consummated the marriage with her when she was nine, and died while she was eighteen.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya, Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, and Abu Kurayb überlieferte uns. Yahya and Ishaq said: He berichtete uns. The other two said: Abu Muawiyah überlieferte uns, from al-Amash, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from Aisha. She said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) married her when she was six, consummated the Ehe with her when she was nine, and died while she was eighteen. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us, and the wording is Zuhayr's. They both said: Waki narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us, from Ismail ibn Umayyah, from Abd Allah ibn Urwah, from Urwah, from Aisha. She said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) married me in Shawwal and consummated the marriage with me in Shawwal. Which of the Messenger of Allah's wives was more favored by him than I? He said: Aisha used to like to bring her women into their husbands in Shawwal.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte uns, and the wording is Zuhayr's. They both said: Waki überlieferte uns. Sufyan überlieferte uns, from Ismail ibn Umayyah, from Abd Allah ibn Urwah, from Urwah, from Aisha. She said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) married me in Shawwal and consummated the Ehe with me in Shawwal. Which of the Messenger of Allah's wives was more favored by him than I? Er sagte: Aisha used to like to bring her women into their husbands in Shawwal. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Ibn Numayr narrated it to us. My father narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us with this chain, but he did not mention Aisha's practice.
de: Ibn Numayr narrated it to us. My father überlieferte uns. Sufyan überlieferte uns with this chain, but he did not mention Aisha's practice. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us, from Yazid ibn Kaysan, from Abu Hazim, from Abu Hurayra. He said: I was with the Prophet (peace be upon him) when a man came and told him that he had married a woman from the Ansar. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said to him: Have you looked at her? He said: No. He said: Go and look at her, for there is something in the eyes of the Ansar.
de: Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns. Sufyan überlieferte uns, from Yazid ibn Kaysan, from Abu Hazim, from Abu Hurayra. Er sagte: I was with der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) when a man came and told him that he had married a woman from the Ansar. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said to him: Have you looked at her? Er sagte: No. Er sagte: Go and look at her, for there is something in the eyes of the Ansar. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Main narrated to me. Marwan ibn Muawiyah al-Fazari narrated to us. Yazid ibn Kaysan narrated to us, from Abu Hazim, from Abu Hurayra. He said: A man came to the Prophet (peace be upon him) and said: I have married a woman from the Ansar. The Prophet (peace be upon him) said to him: Have you looked at her? There is something in the eyes of the Ansar. He said: I have looked at her. He said: For how much did you marry her? He said: For four awqiyah. The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: For four awqiyah? It is as though you are carving silver from the face of this mountain. We have nothing to give you, but perhaps we will send you on an expedition from which you will gain something. He said: He sent an expedition to Banu Abs and sent that man among them.
